purpose: Regional discovery leads for manual review. Candidate handles are not approved for ingestion.
review_rules: Confirm the exact public Telegram username and operator identity from first-party or independently corroborated sources.
Assess recent activity, language, regional relevance, corrections history, sourcing transparency and known affiliation.
Reject channels that publish doxxing, private-person targeting, operational violence instructions or granular real-time tactical movements.
Do not enable a candidate until review is documented in source_registry.json and config/channels.json.
